title: Server roles
intro: The roles ARCHON gives out or relies on. Pick one in the menu below to change it.
pick_placeholder: Choose a role setting to change
rules_grant: ARCHON gives this role by itself, so it must sit below ARCHON's role and carry no sensitive permissions.
rules_mute: It must sit below ARCHON's role, carry no sensitive permissions, and differ from every other role here.
rules_staff: ARCHON only opens ticket channels to this role. Bot roles, @everyone and Administrator roles are refused.
footer: Every change is recorded in your mod-log channel.
not_yours: Only the person who opened this panel can use it.
need_perms: You need the Manage Server and Manage Roles permissions to change role settings.
expired: This panel is out of date. Run the command again.
reason_managed: it belongs to a bot or an integration.
reason_above_bot: it sits above ARCHON's role, so ARCHON can't give it. Move ARCHON's role higher in Server Settings > Roles.
reason_above_actor: it sits at or above your own highest role.
reason_mute_conflict: the mute role must be different from every other role here.

hints.member: Saved for reference. No ARCHON feature gives it yet.
hints.mute: Given to members while they are muted.
hints.autorole: Given to every new member when they join.
hints.staff: Can see and answer support tickets.
hints.investor: Given when a member starts an investment.
hints.gamer: Saved for reference. No ARCHON feature gives it yet.
hints.duelist: Given to tic-tac-toe and WRG winners.
hints.dailyinitiate: Given after 3 days of daily rewards in a row.
hints.dailywarrior: Given after 7 days in a row.
hints.dailychampion: Given after 30 days in a row.
hints.dailylegend: Given after 100 days in a row.

already_removed: This role isn't configured, so there is nothing to remove.
admin_only: You need the Manage Server and Manage Roles permissions to change role settings.
